subject: radiology
title: Prostate and emerging selective embolisation

steps.tx: Prostates shrink without surgery. **Prostatic artery embolisation** eases urinary obstruction where glands shrink over months. **Selection favours** large glands with failed drugs and surgical risk. **Bladder and rectal mapping** guards anastomoses before grains fly. **Symptom scores** with flow rates track relief objectively.
steps.say: Prostates shrink without surgery. Prostatic embolisation eases obstruction where glands shrink over months. Selection favours large glands with failed drugs and surgical risk. Bladder with rectal mapping guards neighbours. Symptom scores with flow track relief.

steps.tx: Tiny tortuous feeders test operator skills daily. **Prostatic arteries** twist off internal iliacs varying wildly between patients. **Cone-beam CT** confirms gland-only perfusion before embolising. **Non-target coil protection** blocks vesical and rectal shunts first. **Bilateral closure** beats unilateral where collaterals persist.
steps.say: Tiny tortuous feeders test skills. Prostatic arteries twist off pelvic trunks varying wildly. Cone-beam scans confirm gland-only flow before grains. Coils block bladder and rectal shunts first. Bilateral closure beats unilateral where collaterals persist.

steps.tx: Burning and blood alarm early. **Post-PAE dysuria with haematuria** settles with fluids and time. **Rectal ischaemia** from stray grains declares with pain and bleeding needing surgery. **Bladder wall injury** shows with haematuria and pain needing catheter rest. **Urinary retention** after swelling needs temporary catheterisation.
steps.say: Burning and blood alarm early. Post-procedure dysuria with bloody urine settles with fluids. Rectal stray grains declare with pain needing surgery. Bladder injury shows with bloody pain needing catheter rest. Swelling retention needs temporary catheters.

steps.tx: Relief builds slowly over months. **Gland shrinkage** peaks at months with flows improving steadily. **Drug weaning** follows relief where tablets stop stepwise. **Retreatment for regrowth** repeats grains or refers to surgery. **Sexual function** counselling tracks erections with ejaculation changes honestly.
